name: sharanfoundation/acts-foundation-website
description: Sharan Foundation — Christian charity website with donations, fundraisers, recurring billing, hero carousel and multi-language support (India & Nepal).

suggest.phpmailer/phpmailer: Recommended for production SMTP email delivery (overrides the bundled copy)
suggest.setasign/fpdf: Recommended for PDF receipts (overrides the bundled copy)
suggest.razorpay/razorpay: For deeper Razorpay integration (we use direct REST by default)
suggest.stripe/stripe-php: For deeper Stripe integration (we use direct REST by default)

post-install-cmd: @php -r "echo '✓ Composer dependencies installed. Run install.php to set up the database.';"
